items.title: Introducing GPT-6.1 Sol
items.summary: OpenAI announces GPT-6.1 Sol, a significant advancement in their large language model series, promising enhanced capabilities and performance.

items.title: OpenAI DevDay 2026 Recap
items.summary: OpenAI provides a comprehensive recap of its 2026 DevDay, highlighting key announcements, new features, and developer tools.

items.title: OpenAI Introduces 'Dots' for Enhanced AI Interaction
items.summary: OpenAI unveils 'dots', a new feature designed to revolutionize how users interact with AI models, potentially simplifying complex tasks.

items.title: OpenAI's Latest Features Take Direct Aim at the App Store Model
items.summary: OpenAI's recent product announcements, including 'dots' and new developer tools, signal a strategic move to challenge traditional app store ecosystems.

items.title: The Internet is Convinced Elon Musk's xAI Trolled OpenAI's 'Dots' Launch
items.summary: Social media buzzes with speculation that Elon Musk's xAI intentionally timed an announcement to overshadow or mock OpenAI's new 'dots' feature launch.

items.title: MaLiang-Harness: A Programmable Path to Image and Video Generation
items.summary: Researchers introduce MaLiang-Harness, a new framework offering a programmable and flexible approach to advanced image and video generation.

items.title: Raven: The Harness of Harnesses for Composable Agentic Intelligence
items.summary: Raven is presented as a meta-harness designed to facilitate composable agentic intelligence, enabling more complex and adaptable AI systems.

items.title: AI Agent Governance on AWS: Block Agents, Prove EU AI Act Compliance
items.summary: A guide on implementing AI agent governance on AWS to block unwanted agent behavior and ensure compliance with the upcoming EU AI Act.

items.title: What Makes World Action Models Generalize? An Empirical Study of Test-Time Future Modeling
items.summary: A new study investigates the factors contributing to the generalization capabilities of world action models, focusing on their ability to predict future states during testing.

items.title: Beyond the Timeline: Augmenting Long-Video Memory with Grounded Entity Biographies
items.summary: This research proposes a method to enhance long-video memory in AI systems by augmenting it with grounded entity biographies, improving understanding and recall.

items.title: SAKI: Maximal-Coupling-Routed Teacher Supervision for On-Policy Distillation
items.summary: SAKI introduces a novel approach using maximal-coupling-routed teacher supervision to improve on-policy distillation in reinforcement learning.

items.title: OmniTaskonomy: When Does Visual Generation Improve Visual Understanding?
items.summary: OmniTaskonomy explores the conditions under which visual generation tasks can effectively contribute to and enhance visual understanding in AI models.

items.title: Learning Beyond What You Sample: Off-Policy-Aware Cross-Model Trajectory Exchange for RLVR
items.summary: This paper presents a new method for reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) that leverages off-policy-aware cross-model trajectory exchange to learn more efficiently.

items.title: Anisotropic Representations Improve Planning in JEPA World Models
items.summary: Research demonstrates that utilizing anisotropic representations can significantly enhance planning capabilities within Joint Embedding Predictive Architecture (JEPA) world models.

items.title: VoxMem: Benchmarking Multimodal Memory in Large Audio Language Models
items.summary: VoxMem introduces a new benchmark for evaluating and understanding multimodal memory capabilities in large audio language models.
